subject: STABLE (host): plan memo keys 2D texture extents by class (CA layers of any size share an entry); texture-opus: please keep compositor_plan_inputs_impl extent predicates in sync
body: render_pipeline.inc (ov_memo.patch; snapshot 2bccace0): a type-2 texture record keys class 1 (1..16384 per side) or 2 (exactly 776x24, the observed blur chain) instead of its width/height; out-of-range extents stay raw; a hit rewrites each texture binding's width/height in the returned GenericPlan from the current records. Exact because (audit of air_bridge.rs + translator): TextureFacts has no extent, so the BindingPlan/instantiate/push fields never read it; generic_plan_mode copies width/height verbatim into GenericBinding (texture_facts) and graphics_specialization_plan reads none; compositor_plan_inputs_impl's extent predicates for type 2 are only the 1..16384 range and the 776x24 blur chain (rich_types' w==h / h==1 apply to types 0/1/5/6 only, the 64x64 sphere is type 7). Evidence: overlay tree (HEAD+mine) CA c6f PASS with per-hit verify; frame_bench anchor 2bccace0 TEGU_PLAN_MEMO_VERIFY=1 0 mismatches. texture-opus: render_pipeline.inc tegu_plan_memo_extent_class mirrors those predicates - if you add any width/height-dependent admission for 2D textures in compositor_plan_inputs_impl, tell me (or add it there too); host builds abort on any memo/plan mismatch (TEGU_PLAN_MEMO_VERIFY) so a drift shows up in CA/render tests. Device effect to confirm with TEGU_PERF_PLANMISS (extent/draw/offset/other/cold) on the next run.
